profile.headline: Principle Software Engineer of IT infrastructure and nVidia GPU computing
profile.jobTitle: Metis@NASA | 11/2010 – Present Oracle DBA | nVidia GPU Programmer
profile.summary:
Summary: 
Principal Systems amp; Database Engineer | Atlassian Suite Administrator | High-Performance Infrastructure amp; GPU Computing

High-impact Senior Infrastructure Engineer and Database Administrator with 15+ years of experience engineering, securing, and maintaining mission-critical enterprise systems. Proven expertise across heavy-duty database administration (Oracle 19c, PostgreSQL, MySQL), Linux kernel/systems administration, and Atlassian enterprise stack deployment (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket).
Skilled in designing high-availability architectures, performance tuning, hybrid-cloud integration, and hardware acceleration using NVIDIA CUDA and OptiX. 

Core Focus & Capabilities: 
* Database & Systems Architecture: Enterprise Oracle (19c RAC, Data Guard), PostgreSQL, MySQL, enterprise storage, and Linux infrastructure management. 
* Atlassian Stack Administration: End-to-end management, integration, migration, and performance tuning of Jira, Confluence, and Bitbucket. 

* Advanced GPU Computing & 3D Systems: CUDA, NVIDIA Omniverse, OptiX, Vulkan, and C++ pipeline development for high-performance simulation and rendering. 

🛠️ Updated Technical Skills Section

* Database Administration & EngineeringDatabases: Oracle (19c, RAC, Data Guard, Performance Tuning), PostgreSQL, MySQL (Replication/HA), HBase

* Storage & Backups: Enterprise SAN Storage, RAID, Veritas NetBackup, Disaster Recovery (DR)

Systems Administration & Data Center Infrastructure

Operating Systems: Enterprise Linux (Oracle Linux 8/9, CentOS, Red Hat, Kernel Tuning/Development), Windows Server
Networking & Security: TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, NFS, Firewalls, Routing Protocols, System Security Hardening

Data Center Operations: Bare-metal provisioning, server monitoring, rack/stack, incident management, high-availability maintenance

Atlassian Stack Administration

Tools: Jira Software / Jira Service Management, Confluence, Bitbucket Enterprise

Key Tasks: System Administration, User & Security Management, Workflow Automation, Performance Tuning, Upgrades & Migrations

Cloud, High-Performance & GPU Computing

GPU & 3D Acceleration: NVIDIA CUDA, OptiX API, NVIDIA Omniverse, Vulkan, OpenGL, WebGLCloud amp; Virtualization: AWS, Azure, OpenStack, Hybrid-Cloud ArchitectureProgramming, Automation & Tools

Languages: C/C++, Python, Bash Shell Scripting, SQL, Java, JavaScript3D & Graphics Tools: Autodesk Maya (C++ Plugin Development), Blender, AutoCAD, MATLAB

Monitoring & Tooling: Nagios, Git, OpenSearch

positions.title: Metis@NASA | 11/2010 – Present Oracle DBA | nVidia GPU Programmer
positions.description:
•	Administered and optimized a diverse portfolio of Oracle, PostgreSQL, and MySQL databases, ensuring high availability and performance for critical NASA operations.
•	Configured and managed Atlassian Jira, Confluence, and bitbucket Oracle database instances and front-end web systems.
•       Conducted major upgrade of Atlassian jira, confluence,  Bitbucket and fecru from older versions to the current versions. Migrated Oracle database to PostgreSQL. 
•	Built and maintained Linux/UNIX Data Centers at NASA, ensuring robust infrastructure support.
•	Collaborated with developers on ATM Data Warehouse systems (Project Sherlock), contributing to system design and optimization.
•	Installed and configured new Linux servers and data storage systems, enhancing data capacity and accessibility.
•	Implemented Nagios and custom Bash shell scripting for MySQL database availability monitoring, improving system uptime.
•	Performed MySQL database performance bottleneck troubleshooting and benchmarking, leading to significant system improvements.
•	Performed setup and troubleshooting of Matlab cluster systems.
•	Developed shell scripts and Oracle SQL scripts to automate ATM data warehouse systems, increasing efficiency.
•	Designed and implemented Oracle standby systems, enhancing data protection and recovery.
•	Mentored intern students on Mars weather stations 3D animation mission design, Mars City 3D Mission and Moon Base 3D design projects.

positions.title: Senior Oracle DBA and UNIX System Admin
positions.description:
•	Worked in SST as an Oracle and MySQL DBA
•	Worked in SST to build and maintain UNIX Data Center
•	Designed and implemented Network and System Monitoring system.
•	Built and maintained Oracle, MySQL database servers, HDS SAN storage and Veritas Cluster Server, Volume Manager and Netbackup system.
•	Built and customized Bugzilla bug tracking system for SST
•	Maintenance corporate web sites with Apache/MySQL/PHP environment
•	Maintenance SST email gateway and anti-SPAM systems

positions.title: Senior 3D Graphics Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Worked as a senior 3D Graphics Software Engineer SGI IRIX and Linux Cluster system in the Software Development Department.
•	Designed and configured DHCP, DNS and Apache web server for HDS.   
•	Designed and built a Linux graphics cluster system for highway driving simulation upgrade project.
•	Implemented a data backup system to do automatic daily and weekly data backup of all of the data on SGI IRIX, Sun Solaris, Windows and Linux systems.
•	Lead the 24x7 ASP production operations of Federal Highway Driving Simulator lab.
•	Deployed a Samba system for the communication of all of the SGI IRIX, Sun Solaris and Linux, Windows machines to sharing storage, computing and printing recourses. 
•	Constructed CVS on multi-platform systems for development engineering department.
•	Worked with software engineering team to convert 3D geometry and 2D image data between different OS and different applications.
•	Good knowledge of Rational ClearCase Products, Rose, UML, CVS, OSG, OpenGL Performer, OpenGL.
•	Solid TCP/IP networking experience, routing protocols, Security, Firewall, DNS and Samba.
•	Profound experience with trouble shooting in the UNIX/Linux systems, Kernel, and device drivers.
positions.insights: Game Engines, Full-Stack Development and +10 skills

company.name: AAI at Federal Highway Driving Simulator (HDS), McLean, VA

positions.title: Senior 3D Graphics Software Engineer, Product Marketing Manager
positions.description:
•	Worked on System Integration of SGI Altix Supercomputer (up to 128 CPUs), which served as a building block for NASA Pleiades SuperComputer.
•	Identified and resolved hundreds of critical kernel and network-related bugs in the beta OS of SGI Altix, significantly improving system stability and performance.
•	Developed a boot disk clone script for SGI Altix Linux server systems.
•	Designed and implemented verifications of OpenGL Performer, Vizserver, OpenGL Multipipe SDK, and OpenGL Multipipe on SGI IRIX, Linux, and Windows systems.
•	Designed and integrated SGI Tempest graphics cluster workstation system (PC-IG); worked on system software design and device driver integration.
•	Technical lead for SGI IA64 Desktop engineering (SGI 750), with deep understanding of Intel IA64 architecture and Red Hat Linux/IA64 OS.
•	Designed and worked on Maya plug-ins for the Maya to OpenGL Performer data converter project.
•	Installed and configured Oracle 7.3.4 and 8.0.5 on SGI IRIX servers.
•	Installed and configured Directory server and Apache web server.
•	Configured and created a scheduling application for the Altix supercomputer using MySQL.
•	Installed and verified Maya application on SGI IRIX server for movie rendering.
positions.insights: Full-Stack Development, Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and +1 skill
